source.title: CTA - Ridership - Bus Routes - Daily Totals by Route
source.grain: One observed date and bus route; rides are boardings
source.snapshot_note: Original API CSV retained. Selected historical two-month snapshot, not a live feed.

forecast.method: Historical mean for the same route and CTA daytype
forecast.baseline: Last observed ridership for each route in the training period

limitations: Observed Chicago route-day boardings, not unique passengers or Bangladesh service data.
No fares, capacity, GPS, expenses or profit are available in this dataset.
Missing route-days are omitted, not assumed to be zero service or zero demand.
The seven observed-date holdout is one retrospective evaluation, not a validated deployment forecast.
